Players Committee card image of [[Ponda Baba (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Game text of non-Jedi Luke (or a lightsaber he is using) may not target aliens here. During battle, if with a smuggler, may add one destiny to attrition or make that smuggler forfeit = 0.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/pondababa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665 30816d1] (22 June 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
